name: Chotto Meitantei ~Misa-chan Monogatari Series~
original_name: ちょっと名探偵 ～美砂ちゃん物語シリーズ～
source:
Misa-chan is a cute high school student detective. Her father is changed with an accusation in a hit-and-run incident and she is asked to find the real criminal. Her best friend Kanako will assist in this task.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美砂是一名可爱的高中生侦探。父亲因一宗肇事逃逸案蒙冤遭到起诉，她受托找出真凶。挚友加奈子会协助她调查。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
